services.label: Services
services.headline: From the ecosystem to the software behind it
services.sectionSubtitle: From intelligent agent ecosystems to comprehensive software development, we build solutions that transform your operations.
services.aiAgentsDesc: We design and deploy autonomous digital agent ecosystems that orchestrate complex processes, make real-time decisions and continuously optimize your operations.
services.apiDesc: We connect your existing systems with the agent ecosystems, with no friction and no forced migrations.
services.webDesc: Modern, scalable web platforms with intuitive interfaces and high performance.
services.mobileDesc: Native and cross-platform applications designed to integrate with your agent ecosystems.
services.backendDesc: Robust architectures and scalable APIs to support your digital operations.
services.devopsDesc: Automated infrastructure, continuous integration and monitoring for reliable, scalable operations.
services.securityDesc: Comprehensive data and system protection: every agent declares what it accesses, what it writes and leaves an auditable trail.

howItWorks.step5Description: Our agents learn continuously, improving their performance and adapting to your environment.

aboutPage.heroHeadline: Three engineers who learned to build this<1> by building it</1>.
aboutPage.heroPhotoAlt: Breakaway's three founders at the Centro de Congresos in Querétaro
aboutPage.introText: We studied Computer Science and Technologies at Tec de Monterrey, Querétaro campus, and founded Breakaway before we graduated. Today we have agent ecosystems running in production.
aboutPage.storyHeadline: Our first client arrived before our degrees did.
aboutPage.storyText1: They hired us while we were still students, for a project bigger than anything we had built until then. We took it, delivered it and put it into production.
aboutPage.storyText2: Then so much work came in that there were weeks when deliveries mattered more than classes. After graduating we went all in on Breakaway. We still work the same way: we commit to the outcome and build whatever it takes to reach it.
aboutPage.storyPhotoAlt: The founders on graduation day at Tec de Monterrey
aboutPage.foundersIntro: There's no middle layer. All three founders work on the projects and answer to the client directly.
aboutPage.foundersDegree: Computer Science and Technologies · Tec de Monterrey
aboutPage.founder1Desc: Responsible for the architecture of the agent ecosystems and the technical decisions behind every implementation.
aboutPage.founder2Desc: Responsible for the company's direction, its financial structure and the commercial scope of every project.
aboutPage.founder3Desc: Responsible for operations and for making sure every delivery reaches production on time and working.
aboutPage.talksHeadline: We get invited to explain where this is heading
aboutPage.talk1Title: Panel on AI and professional development
aboutPage.talk1Desc: We shared our view on AI and how it is reshaping the path for young people and professional growth.
aboutPage.talk1Alt: The founders during the Agentic 2026 panel
aboutPage.talk2Desc: Alongside Shuya Gong and Javier Weddington.
aboutPage.talk2Alt: The team with Shuya Gong and Javier Weddington at Descúbrete+ Summit
aboutPage.stance1Desc: A misunderstood process<1> doesn't improve just because you put a model on top of it</1>. We start by mapping how your team works today.
aboutPage.stance2Title: With permissions and a paper trail
aboutPage.stance2Desc: Every agent declares which systems it enters and what it can write, and leaves an<1> auditable record</1> of every action it runs.
aboutPage.stance3Title: We'll tell you no when that's the right call
aboutPage.stance3Desc: Some processes<1> aren't worth automating yet</1>. We'd rather say so during the assessment than have you find out halfway through the project.
aboutPage.ctaHeadline: Which process is weighing you down?
aboutPage.ctaText: The first conversation is a free assessment. We'll tell you frankly whether an agent solves your problem, or whether it isn't worth it.
